stem: A supplier says a new speaker gives Voltmarkt "a 50% margin": it costs €100 and sells for €150 net. What is wrong with the claim?

options.text: The gross margin is 66.7%, since cost is two thirds of the price
Nothing: margin and markup are equal when the price is net
That is a 50% markup; the gross margin is 33.3%
The margin is right, but the markup is only 33.3%
